notes_zh:
- **新增** 设置里新增「软件更新」页，可以查看新版本、更新内容和下载进度；自动检查、参与 Beta 测试等更新设置也挪到了这里
- **新增** 「自动安装更新」开关（默认关闭）：新版本在后台下载，电脑闲置时自动安装并重启 PasteMemo
- **优化** 发现新版本时不再弹出更新窗口打断当前操作（全屏游戏、视频也会被拉出来），改为系统通知，状态栏图标和设置里的「软件更新」会有标记
- **修复** 「检查频率」默认显示每 24 小时，实际每 6 小时检查一次
- **修复** 下载更新时点「取消」，过一会儿又弹出「下载失败」
- **修复** 设置窗口已经打开时，点自动化规则里的「去设置」不会跳到对应页面
notes_en:
- **New** A Software Update page in Settings shows the new version, what's new and download progress; update settings such as automatic checks and the beta channel moved here
- **New** "Install updates automatically" (off by default): new versions download in the background and install when your Mac is idle, then PasteMemo restarts
- **Improve** A new version no longer pops up an update window over what you're doing (full-screen games and videos included); you get a system notification instead, and the menu bar icon and Software Update in Settings show a badge
- **Fix** Check interval showed "Every 24 hours" by default but checked every 6 hours
- **Fix** Canceling an update download showed "Download Failed" shortly after
- **Fix** With Settings already open, "Open settings" in an automation rule didn't jump to the right page
